title: How Binary Search ACTUALLY Works Under The Hood 🧠
caption: Why mid = (low + high) / 2 has an integer overflow bug in Java/C++! Did you know this? #dsa #computerscience #algorithms #programmingtips
transcript: Most people write low plus high divided by two, but in Java and C++, when low and high are huge, their sum overflows into negative numbers! Use low plus (high minus low) divided by two instead. Here is the visual proof.
description: Concise, high-educational value explanation of binary search arithmetic overflow and pointer safety.
